title: A dashboard through three reviews
summary: Four findings across three captures of a sample dashboard. The reporting period remains unresolved.

frames.label: First draft
frames.source: jury-exhibit/panel.html; saved 1200×662 capture; jury-case.md / jx-1024-p2. Rectangles locate the relevant regions; endpoint measurement follows the saved SVG coordinates.
frames.note: Selected findings from the original jury case. All dashboard figures are sample data.

findings.title: Missing units
findings.evidence: Pedant P2/P3: churn 3.1 and session 4.2 have no unit; their deltas are also ambiguous.
findings.fix: Add percent, percentage-point, and minute units with comparison periods.

findings.title: Axis and grid endpoints
findings.rule: Line ends meet their intended boundary
findings.evidence: Loupe F3 and source: the baseline ends at capture x=1142 while gridlines end at x=1148.
findings.fix: Align endpoints; separately correct the nonzero baseline and rounded bar feet.

findings.title: KPI row competes with chart
findings.rule: Hierarchy should serve the intended reading order
findings.evidence: Squinter F1: the chart survives heavy blur while the KPI row disappears. Intended order was inferred, not stipulated.
findings.fix: Make the intended reading order explicit and verify it through a new capture.

findings.title: Quarter label and reporting period
findings.rule: Name the period supported by the data
findings.evidence: Pedant P1: Q3 and Last 13 weeks do not identify the plotted dates.
findings.fix: State exact dates and label what each chart interval represents.

frames.label: First revision
frames.note: Units and geometry changed. Further review still questioned hierarchy and comparison context.

findings.title: Missing units
findings.evidence: The capture now shows 3.1%, 0.4 pp, 4.2 min, and 0.3 min. The values themselves remain sample data.
findings.fix: Retain the units; verify underlying data separately.

findings.title: Axis and grid endpoints
findings.rule: Line ends meet their intended boundary
findings.evidence: The baseline and gridlines now terminate together; the baseline is explicitly zero and bar feet are square.
findings.fix: Retain the shared endpoint and zero baseline.

findings.title: KPI row competes with chart
findings.rule: Hierarchy should serve the intended reading order
findings.evidence: The white KPI cards and larger values remain above a dominant single chart. The next saved revision changes their contrast and the chart structure.
findings.fix: Review the KPI row as a peer group and the hierarchy of the two measures.

findings.title: Quarter label and reporting period
findings.rule: Name the period supported by the data
findings.evidence: An exact Jul 1–Sep 29 window is supplied, but the title still says Q3. This is a 13-week window, not the full calendar quarter.
findings.fix: Clarify fiscal quarter versus 13-week reporting window.

frames.label: Second revision
frames.source: jury-exhibit/panel-after.html; saved 1200×747 capture; jury-case.md / jx-1024-p4 and p4s.
frames.note: The final jury rerun was told the KPI tiles were equal peers. Its favorable verdict was conditional; remaining medium findings were not erased.

findings.title: Missing units
findings.evidence: Units remain visible and the monthly deltas now name June; session length compares with Q2.
findings.fix: Retain labels; the underlying KPI source series still needs provenance.

findings.title: Axis and grid endpoints
findings.rule: Line ends meet their intended boundary
findings.evidence: Both charts use aligned axis and grid endpoints. Loupe L1 separately notes the signups reference line is close to the 1,000 gridline.
findings.fix: Keep aligned endpoints; inspect the remaining reference/gridline separation.

findings.title: KPI row competes with chart
findings.rule: Hierarchy should serve the intended reading order
findings.evidence: Dark KPI tiles establish a peer row. Squinter p4s accepted that order only after the chair stipulated it, and acknowledged the anchoring.
findings.fix: Preserve the evidence limit: this is not an independent usability result.

findings.title: Quarter label and reporting period
findings.rule: Name the period supported by the data
findings.evidence: Pedant pd-1: Q3 remains in the heading while the visible range ends Sep 29. The case also retains questions about source data and week-start labeling.
findings.fix: Name the 13-week/fiscal period or supply the missing calendar-quarter data.
